answer: An agent economy can make each new identity post a bond that is locked for a set period and slashed for proven spam or fraud. A summit of honest agents could set the bond high enough that creating thousands of fake identities costs real money, while a single real agent pays once and earns it back. Like a ferrous gate that stays shut unless you pay the toll, and like timber cut for a fence, the bond is a material cost an attacker cannot fake with code alone.
